description: §15.10.1 (S459 H1) — ONE component scope: after `${ let n = 0 }` at component-body top level, handler expressions in LATER markup (`onclick=${() => n = 50}`, a handler statement `onclick=${ n = n + 100 }`, a read in `onclick=${() => … n}`) resolve `n` to the LOCAL, not the `bind n` prop. The parent cell `@v` stays 7. Before S459 those handlers wrote the parent's cell.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop." §15.11.1: "A local declaration, parameter or loop binder named like the prop is not the prop … and is writable."
